key_policy: Unique under Unicode casefold across this edition and the existing public edition. A base key of FirstAuthorFamily + year + first title word is used when free. On collision the key gains _oa plus the first eight hex digits of SHA256(OpenAlex work ID). Keys are stable for a given snapshot and slice; openalex_id gives the source record.
